card.name: Digits inside phone numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit in the middle of a phone number, usually just before a hyphen or the final group of digits. It appears in contact lines in news, press releases and travel listings.

modes.label: Digit before hyphen
modes.description: A digit in the middle group of a hyphenated phone number, such as 8, 0 or 2.

modes.label: International numbers
modes.description: A digit inside a long phone number that starts with a country code, such as +41 or 34-93.

card.plain: It marks a digit in the middle of a phone number in a contact line.
